# link { #crossrepo.cache.link }

```python
crossrepo.cache.link(blob, dest)
```

Expose a cached object under a readable name.

A hard link is preferred, a symbolic link is the first fallback and a copy
the last, so the function works on filesystems that support neither.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**blob**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Cached object to expose.

<code>[**dest**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Path to create. An existing path is reused when it already stands for `blob`, cached content being immutable, and is replaced otherwise, so that a link left by an earlier cache layout is never trusted.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   `dest`.
